notes.title: Update #3 - Difficulty Levels
notes.notes:
Welcome Survivors!

Game Update #3
- Added Difficulty Settings when starting a new game, not dropping items on death is also an option

- New late game weapon: Spectral Shotgun

- Crafting Tab Reworked: when interacting with a crafting station, only the station's recipes will be displayed

- Interaction HUD will properly display the name of crafting stations

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44193960/3a7aaf646f1a32b8d36b3ebf7db5f37e95a88e02.png"]


The Dev's recommendation:
World: Easy & Character: Softcore is best suited for those who want to focus more on exploring the world and worry less about the danger level of enemies.

World: Normal & Character: Normal is the standard experience where enemies are a real danger.

World: Expert is just brutal. Most enemies will kill you with two shots, maybe more if you equip the right gear. Combined with Character Difficulty: Softcore it will make the experience a bit smoother since you can get right back to action not having to worry about retrieving lost items. But combined with Character Difficulty: Normal the player will be heavily punished for every single mistake.



Join the Discord Server and tell me about your experience and potential feedback! Have fun!

notes.title: Date Release Announcement & Big Demo Update
notes.notes:
The Wait is Almost Over – Desolated District Release Date Revealed!

We're thrilled to finally announce the official release date for Desolated District! Mark your calendars: May 22nd is the day the full experience goes live.

To celebrate this milestone, we’ve prepared a brand-new trailer showcasing new content, updated visuals, and a glimpse at what awaits you in the full game.

[previewyoutube=LM9U1wMx4nQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Final Demo Content Update – Available Now!

Alongside the release date announcement, we’re also rolling out one last content update for the demo. This update introduces new features, balance tweaks, and fresh content to give players a final taste of what's to come

Quest System
Biome System
Added the Slime Boss
New Zone: The Slug Nest
New Creature: the Hoarder Slug
Total UI Refactor
Metal Tower Parkour reworked
Slime Enemy Balance
New Main Menu Scene
Rooftops small visual changes

Your support has meant the world to us. We can’t wait to share the full version with you and see what you build, explore, and survive in Desolated District.

Wishlist now and stay tuned for more updates as we approach launch day!

notes.title: Final Demo Update Incoming
notes.notes:
Big things are coming to Desolated District!

We’re excited to announce that the final demo update will be launching on April 27th on Steam!

This update is packed with content:

 New enemies lurking in unexplored corners

In the meantime, feel free to join our Discord for sneak peeks, dev updates, and to chat with fellow survivors.

notes.title: Major Enemy Update - Demo Update 12
notes.notes:
Happy new year, survivors!

Here's the new update news:

 major enemy update (AI, attack patterns, sfx, vfx, spawn, respawn, performance improvements)
 enemies run on a new AI system with better performance
 maggots attack rework: they have a ranged attack, spitting acid at the player when getting in their attack range
 maggots slight visual changes
 added lots of new sfx and vfx for the slimes and maggots
 fixed a bug where enemy loot could not be picked up
 new item description for: seeds and Mining Helmet
 changed the Metal Tower parkour to be easier
 added 1 Bread in the spawning room (you should eat it)


Have fun and expect more updates and changes to come soon!
